Pésima atención, el señor del turno tarde de las 14 hs, del día 28 de agosto, nos atendió muy mal, y con malos modales,  además, porque no sólo nos ofreció la comida de mala manera, sino que no nos quiso calentar la comida porque dijo que estaba comiendo …!!! YPF y ACÁ no pueden tener esta persona atendiendo a clientes que llegan de todas partes del país, y del mundo, llegue con mi señora y mis 3 hijos solo buscando algo para almorzar de paso y nos encontramos con esto, realmente muy lamentable…!!!

(Translated by Google)
Terrible service! The gentleman on the 2 PM shift on August 28th treated us very badly and rudely. Not only did he offer our food rudely, but he also refused to heat it up because he said he was eating…!!! YPF and ACÁ cannot have this kind of person serving customers who come from all over the country and the world. I arrived with my wife and three children just looking for a quick lunch, and we encountered this. Truly deplorable…!!!

This beautiful place combines excellent service with stunning scenery. It's a highly recommended spot to stop and admire the surrounding landscape—very tranquil and relaxing. The locals are very friendly and offer helpful directions to your destination. The prices are good, and I recommend the Infinia fuel; it's more expensive than the Super, but it's worth it for traveling longer distances with lower fuel consumption.
